title: Social and Economic Impact of IT
status: reference implementation content; lesson content remains subject to teacher review

lessons.title: Computer security, misuse and who is affected
objectives: Outline computer security, cybersecurity and computer misuse, including vulnerability, threat, attack and countermeasure
Assess the impact of misuse on individuals, organisations and government
activities: Classify a scenario as vulnerability, threat, attack or countermeasure
Identify who is affected by an IT misuse scenario
Analyse a cyberbullying or hacked-system scenario

lessons.title: Countermeasures and personal security practices
objectives: Describe suitable physical and software countermeasures for identified threats
activities: Classify security controls as physical or software

lessons.title: Impact on job skills and careers
objectives: Explore how IT changes job skills and careers
activities: Discuss a scenario involving automation and work

lessons.title: Impact of ICT on education, medicine, business, law enforcement and recreation
objectives: Explore effects of ICT across major areas of society
activities: Evaluate benefits and possible effects in a scenario
Compare ICT impact across two sectors

lessons.title: Enrichment: health, safety and ethics
objectives: Consider health, safety and ethical issues associated with IT
activities: Classify health, safety and ethical scenarios
Reflect on safe and ethical technology use

sourceExampleScenario: The workbook includes scenarios such as cyberbullying and a hacked hospital system for applying security concepts.
knowledgeCheckGuidance: Generate checks from the lesson objectives and the workbook's key terms/check-your-understanding structure. Teacher answer keys are not included here.
